title: Tanzania pharmaceutical market overview | Nazryx
description: Tanzania, one of Nazryx's 14 markets: more than 80% of medicines imported, a state buyer spending about USD 491m a year, and generics approved in about 61 days.

sections.title: Tanzania:
sections.lede: A market that imports most of its medicines, buys centrally for thousands of public facilities, and has cut generic approval times sharply.

items.title: Import-led
items.text: More than 80% of medicines and devices are imported. Local output covers 10–20% of demand.

items.title: One big buyer
items.text: MSD buys about USD 491m of health commodities a year for 8,800+ public facilities.

items.title: Faster approvals
items.text: Average approval time for generics fell from 202 days in 2020 to 61 days in 2022.
